title: Myles Garrett trade gets blunt reaction from Trent Williams: 'It sucks'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Myles Garrett trade gets blunt reaction from Trent Williams: 'It sucks'
sources.description: 49ers OT Trent Williams evidently isn't looking forward to facing Myles Garrett twice a year after the star pass rusher was traded to the Rams.
